name: Stone Walls
source:
Cold stone. Darkness. Nothing else.

You awaken in an unfamiliar place, with no clear memory of how you came there. As you explore, something slowly begins to return — fragments, objects, impressions. Something lost. Something you may not want to face.

Stone Walls is a dark narrative adventure with exploration, environmental storytelling, and light puzzle elements.

Three phases. Nine rooms. There is no right path. Only yours.

[From [url=https://csimbi.itch.io/stone-walls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冰冷的石墙，无边的黑暗，除此之外空无一物。

你在陌生的地方醒来，完全记不清自己是如何来到这里的。随着探索一步步推进，某些东西开始缓缓浮现——记忆碎片、旧日器物、模糊印象。那是某种失落之物，也是某种你或许并不愿直面的真相。

《石墙》是一部融合了探索调查、环境叙事与轻度解谜要素的黑暗叙事冒险游戏。

三个阶段，九间密室。这里没有所谓的正确道路，唯有属于你的路。

[摘自[url=https://csimbi.itch.io/stone-walls]itch.io[/url]]
